title: EC21006: Electromagnetic Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Maxwell s equations: displacement current, equation of continuity, boundary
conditions; propagation of uniform plane waves in unbounded medium: reflection,
refraction, phase and group velocities; transmission lines and waveguides:
modes, design, travelling waves, standing waves, pulse propagation,
characteristic impedance, cut-off frequency, attenuation, dispersion, powerhandling capability; Smith chart and impedance matching techniques; radiation
concept: elementary dipole, half-wave dipole, radiation patterns, gain, pattern
multiplication, other basic antennas.

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion

How to Crack the Paper
Attend classes(it counts in your final grade).

Do the MATLAB assignement nicely.

Properly do the derivations done in class (a handful will come in exam and expect them to be very lengthy)
